1) Thu 9/9 10:00–10:30 PT (1:00–1:30 ET)
2) Thu 9/9 15:00–15:30 PT (18:00–18:30 ET) — late option for APAC overlap
3) Mon 9/13 09:30–10:00 PT (12:30–13:00 ET)

Can you confirm which of these works for you and who on your side will join? If none work, send two windows that suit stakeholders and we’ll adapt.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
